geometric_inspection: The code forms a quadratic Bezier through throat-arc endpoint N and exit E using their tangent-line intersection P1. For nondegenerate nonparallel control vectors this is a parabolic segment, and endpoint derivative directions equal theta_n and theta_e by construction. This is reviewer mathematical reasoning from code, consistent with the canted-parabola concept in Figure 5(a); it is not a source-stated Bezier algorithm.

The code computes Re=sqrt(epsilon)*Rt and Ln=(length_pct/100)*(Re-Rt)/tan(15 degrees). The source comparison window does not independently establish all contour/default-radius and normalization details; no blanket geometric equivalence or optimum-performance claim is made.

lookup_angles uses bilinear RegularGridInterpolator with extrapolation enabled (bounds_error=False, fill_value=None). rao_chart_domain_status reports the repository grid (epsilon 4-50, length 60-100 percent); grid membership does not verify ordinates or physical applicability.
